Advances: bw.signal.adoption

Deliverable:
Vault + one adopted repo — NOT beadwork source. ~/Documents/my-vault/LLMs/skills/orchestrate-epic/SKILL.md: dual-mode marker consumption — when the adopted repo defines signal types, poll `bw signal query --since` and consume typed records; otherwise comment-marker parse unchanged; the brittle machinery (first-non-blank-non-quoted-line parse, quote stripping, jq comment polling, last_bounce_handled_at debounce) goes unused in signals mode. ~/Documents/my-vault/LLMs/skills/implement/SKILL.md: emit via `bw signal emit` in signals mode; comment-marker posting preserved for non-adopted repos. The adopted repo gains .beadwork/signals.yml + .beadwork/hooks/ defining ALL 10 MARKERS.md markers as signal types (verify/audit/bounce_boundary per the refined plan Decision 6; routing targets as enum payload fields) with an enrich attribution hook (session stamp from spawner env, refuse if absent) and a completed gate.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: manual end-to-end acceptance run (see Call-site Integration); source review of both SKILL.md dual-mode sections
- Behaviors to demonstrate: bw.signal.adoption.bounce_loop_in_signals_mode, bw.signal.adoption.non_adopted_repo_unchanged
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: skill-file edits reviewed against MARKERS.md; adopted-repo config validated with `bw signal types` and a scratch emit per type.
  - Final tier: the full end-to-end epic run on the adopted repo in signals mode, run-until-green.
  - Verifier tier: verify the epic transcript/tickets show typed-signal consumption only; do NOT re-run the epic.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path
  - Fixture/sandbox hygiene covered: scratch emits cleaned off the adopted repo beadwork branch before the acceptance run
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (signals mode vs comment mode on adopted vs non-adopted repos)
- Call-site Integration: the production caller is a live /orchestrate-epic + /implement run on the adopted repo. Proving run: a full bounce-loop epic (VERIFY: FAIL → AUDIT: BOUNCE → implementer → completed) driven with the comment-marker parser disabled, asserting the orchestrator reacted solely to typed signal records — every one of the 10 markers defined, zero prose-parse use. Record the run evidence as a comment on this ticket.

Out of Scope (files):
- /Users/mz/src/beadwork/** and this worktree src (no beadwork source changes in this stage)
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- ~/Documents/my-vault/LLMs/skills/orchestrate-epic/SKILL.md
- ~/Documents/my-vault/LLMs/skills/implement/SKILL.md
- /Users/mz/dev/cs/builder/.beadwork/signals.yml (adopted repo pinned by user 2026-07-11)
- /Users/mz/dev/cs/builder/.beadwork/hooks/**
- .spec/specs/signal_adoption.spec.md (verification stub flips execute:false->true only)

Out of Scope (intent):
- Exactly one adopted repo — no fleet-wide migration (post-v1, gated on fleet adoption).
- Do NOT delete comment-marker mode from the skills; dual-mode is the deliverable, deletability is the proof.
- No MARKERS.md rewrite beyond what dual-mode wording requires; the annex stays normative.
- No upstreaming or sharing with Jason in this stage.

Merge gate:
- [ ] Skill edits reviewed (dual-mode gating correct for non-adopted repos)
- [ ] All 10 markers defined and emittable on the adopted repo
- [ ] End-to-end epic run in signals mode with zero prose-parse use, evidence on ticket
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
